title: Statistics Analyzer — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Calculates descriptive statistics and runs standard statistical tests. The Statistics Analyzer calculates descriptive statistics and statistical tests. From a dataset it produces means, medians, modes, standard deviations, and quartiles, then runs standard tests — t-tests, chi-square, correlation, regression — with the test statistic, p-value, and a plain-language interpretation. It states each test's assumptions and warns when they are not met.
capabilities: Descriptive statistics: mean, median, spread, quartiles
t-tests, chi-square, correlation, regression
Plain-language interpretation of results
State test assumptions and check them
Warn when assumptions are not met
